title: BetterCraft
description: We Crafted better textures with community
body:
**BetterCraft – Upgrade Your Minecraft World!**

BetterCraft is a texture pack that enhances classic blocks and game elements, adding more detail, vibrant colors, and a pleasing texture – all to make your Minecraft look better while keeping its natural vibe. From grass to diamonds, every block gets a subtle upgrade that makes the world feel more alive and immersive.

⚠️ WARNING: It’s not recommended to use BetterCraft alongside other texture packs that alter block or item appearances, as this can cause visual conflicts and ruin the BetterCraft experience.|
